Its error is wrapped in `ExecutionError::AmbiguousOutcome`, which is not retryable and converts to a `DomainError` telling the agent to verify whether the operation completed. An idempotent step's error stays bare.
238:- `error()`: the first root cause as `ExecutionError::StepFailed`, which converts to `DomainError`. When no step failed in its own right (a cancelled run, or a rebuilt record with pending steps) it names the first step that did not succeed, so `error()` is `None` only for a `Succeeded` run.
379:**A completed step proves its prerequisites completed.** Before deciding anything, resume (and `RunRecord::from_parts`) applies that rule down the graph: a prerequisite of a `Completed` or `CompletedEarlier` step that is missing from the saved records, or saved only as `Pending` or `Running`, becomes `CompletedEarlier` with the reason "inferred from a completed dependent", and its own prerequisites likewise. This covers a store that lost some writes (say B's finished record was saved but A's was not): A is not run again. A prerequisite recorded in a state that contradicts the dependent (`Failed`, `Skipped`, `NotRun`, `Panicked` or `OutcomeUnknown`) cannot come from a real run, so the record is refused with `ResumeError::ContradictoryRecord { step_id, step_status, prerequisite, prerequisite_status }` (a `Conflict` as a `DomainError`) and nothing runs.

## `redact` — Best-Effort Redaction

```rust
pub const REDACTED: &str = "[REDACTED]";

pub fn redact_secrets(text: &str, secrets: &[&str]) -> String;
pub fn redact_url_userinfo(text: &str) -> String;
```

Not re-exported at the crate root; use `michi_core::redact::…`.

- `redact_secrets` replaces each known secret with `[REDACTED]`. Empty secrets are ignored, the longest secret wins when one contains another, and the text is scanned once, so the marker is never searched again and redacting twice changes nothing.
- `redact_url_userinfo` replaces the `user:password@` part of every `scheme://…` URL. A URL ends at whitespace, a quote, a backtick, `<` or `>`; everything up to the last `@` inside it is userinfo, so a password containing `@` or `/` is removed whole. A URL with no userinfo but an `@` later in its path (`https://host/pkg@1.2`) is over-redacted; that is the safe direction. Email addresses are not URLs and pass through.
- Neither finds secrets in general. They are a second line of defense after keeping secrets out of messages. `DomainError::from_error` and `from_error_with_causes` apply `redact_url_userinfo` to the error text they copy, because URLs with credentials are the common leak in errors from HTTP and database clients. `DomainError::new`, `cause` and `hint` take tool-author text and do not redact it.

# michi-pipeline

## 0.10.0

_2026-11-15 · [compare](https://github.com/orin-dx/michi/compare/michi-pipeline@0.9.0...michi-pipeline@0.10.0)_

- Released together with the `michi` fixed group.

## 0.9.0

- `CircuitBreaker` and `BreakerRegistry::breaker()` are no longer public. A standalone breaker could be created and its phase read, but nothing could drive it; breakers are used through `ExecOptions::breakers` and a `BreakerRegistry`. Read a breaker's phase with `BreakerRegistry::phase(key)`, which returns `None` until a step has used that key. `BreakerConfig`, `BreakerPhase` and `BreakerRegistry` are unchanged.

## 0.8.0

- Replay and resume hardening: retries and resume no longer repeat work that may already have taken effect in seven more cases.
  
  - `resume` uses the stricter of the replay class stored in the record and the class the plan's step reports now. A step edited from idempotent to not idempotent since the run is held for verification instead of being invoked again. The plan fingerprint still covers structure only; swapping a runner for one with other side effects is your responsibility. A step that was not idempotent when it ran stays held even if the plan now calls it idempotent.

T4: draft PR https://github.com/orin-dx/michi/pull/120 (branch fix/pipeline-error-redaction).

Outcomes
- #1 fixed. `From<ExecutionError> for DomainError` now writes fixed `message` text (`http 502`, `the step reported an error`, `step panicked`, `deadline passed`). The step's own text goes into one `causes` entry, redacted and cut to 512 bytes.
- #2 fixed. New `redact_common_shapes` is used by both `from_error` variants. It covers query and `key=value` secrets and the ghp_/github_pat_/npm_/pypi-/Bearer prefixes. `redact_url_userinfo` now also handles `:\/\/`, `%3A%2F%2F` and a `"` in a password. It runs to a fixed point, so redacting twice equals once. The docs now state what is and is not covered.
- #9 partly done. Added fuzz targets `redact` and `error_text`; they ran 1.2M and 620k times with no crash. The NAPI decoder (`napi/input.rs`) cannot be driven by cargo-fuzz because it needs a Node runtime, so that part is skipped; it needs a Node-side property test.

Decisions
- Breaking change, changeset is minor for michi-core and michi-pipeline.
- Fuzzing found `redact_secrets` is not idempotent when a secret matches part of the marker (`RED`, `[`). I documented it rather than changing it.
- Outside my files: one-line edits to the `fuzz.yml` matrix and the justfile comment; an updated expectation in `domain_error_causes.rs`.
